name: Wuxi Taiji Industry Limited Corporation
summary: Wuxi Taiji Industry Limited Corporation engages in the semiconductor, engineering technology service, and photovoltaic power station investment and operation businesses. The company provides IC chip packaging, packaging testing, and module assembly and testing services; after-sales service; construction projects; and engineering technical services, including engineering consulting and survey. It also offers services to downstream power companies. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Wuxi, China.
